_comment: Brand-agnostic creative-engine enforcement rules for Athletes Acceleration. Consumed by scripts/validate-plan.mjs via loadRules(). Brand #2 ships its own data/rules.<brand>.json; absent file falls back to DEFAULT_RULES in validate-plan.mjs.
_beatRolesNote: anyOf = the beat's VALID role set; an asset must carry >=1 (playbook: 1 dominant + ~2 supporting, ONE dominant beat per static). guarantee is enforced separately (guaranteeDrift), not as a required F role.
